ramraj_values.brand_column_shape: Prod Grp1 (QB_MDJMD_SALES_5YRS_SUMMARY.ProdGrp1) was evaluated as the replacement dimension for 'brand' on Sales questions and rejected. Its 55 values mix product types (DHOTI, BANIANS, TOWEL, ACCESSORIES, FABRIC), standalone brands (CULTURE CLUB, PRIMA CLUB, LINEN PARK, GENISTAA) and brand-product lines (RAMRAJ PANT, RAMRAJ SHIRT, VIVEAGHAM DHOTI), plus non-product entries (LOT, SCRAP ITEM, COMBO). It is a product-line dimension, not a brand dimension, and it holds no value 'RAMRAJ'. Brand on PBI_ENES_ORDER_PENDING_SUMMARY has the same shape (RAMRAJ DHOTI, RAMRAJ HANKEYS...). Neither table represents brand as its own field.
